schema.purpose: Передача полного рабочего контекста проекта Aishin следующему чату ChatGPT без смешивания с другими проектами.

transcript_fidelity.user_prompts: Ключевые пользовательские реплики текущей последовательности сохранены дословно там, где они доступны в контексте.

canonical_project.hard_exclusion: Не смешивать Aishin с отдельным проектом TooruDragon / Дракончик Тоору.

implemented_architecture.details: Машиночитаемая личность, system prompt, public summary, self-model.
Постоянное состояние, heartbeat, журнал событий; heartbeat создаётся заново в lifespan.
Отдельный профиль Господина с source/confidence.
Совместная история, решения и договорённости Айшин и Господина.
Хронология важных событий и изменений.
Изоляция scope; confidence, importance, tags, source, status, superseded_by.
Grounded extraction, evidence, dedup, reinforcement, supersession, conflict preservation, secret filtering, memory_changes audit.
Cloud.ru embeddings + SQLite vector persistence + hybrid lexical/semantic retrieval + lexical fallback.
Scoped entities, relations, evidence, graph_changes audit; grounded extraction from conversation.
Goals, tasks, priorities, dependencies, due dates, blockages, cycle protection, scope isolation, planner_changes.
Read-only runtime/modules/planner/filesystem sensors; protected paths excluded.
Permission-gated tools, dry_run, per-action approval, local-only real mutations, audit redaction.
observe → evaluate → propose → pending → approve/reject → execute → audit; resolved proposals auto-dismiss.
UI карточек «Айшин заметила», approve/reject/execute, pending/approved separation, live sensors.
Визуальный поток фактического состояния, Working Memory, события, reasoning карточек решений.
Детерминированная оценка evidence/confidence/contradictions до Cloud.ru; confident/cautious/needs_verification/insufficient_data.

При verification/needs_verification/insufficient_data расширяет память, semantic search, graph, sensors, явно указанные безопасные файлы, выполняет Cloud.ru consistency check только по собранным evidence, затем повторно запускает Metacognition до финального ответа.

Dynamic FAST/DEEP/VERIFY/PLAN/DIAGNOSE controller, deterministic Rule Engine, Evidence Chain, Contradiction Resolver and technical Decision Journal. VERIFY/DIAGNOSE force Verification Engine before final answer. No private chain-of-thought is stored.

Two-phase context selection. Logic Mode controls budgets for chat history, memories, graph entities, planner items, verification findings and sensors. Final Cloud.ru prompt is rebuilt from selected context, source data is not deleted.

Conservative causal classification: observed, temporal, contributory, causal_candidate. Causal confidence is capped and reduced by contradictions; correlation/sequence is not silently promoted to causality.
Competing hypotheses for VERIFY/DIAGNOSE, normalized confidence, supporting/opposing evidence, discriminating-test selection and stop rule.
Feedback-grounded strategy learning. Only explicit later user success/failure feedback updates reliability; own assistant output is never treated as success evidence.
Mode-aware what-if analysis for DEEP/PLAN/VERIFY/DIAGNOSE. Produces possible effects, risks, reversibility, evidence and bounded confidence. Scenarios are explicitly not guaranteed forecasts.
Scores quality of decision basis using logic confidence, evidence, verification, uncertainty, contradictions, alternative coverage and reversibility. Score does not claim objective correctness.

Ranks candidate actions after Counterfactual + Decision Quality using expected benefit, risk, reversibility, permission friction and unresolved uncertainty. Selection is proposal-only and never executes Tool Registry automatically.

current_cognitive_flow: Logic Learning checks explicit feedback about previous strategy
Logic Evidence Chain + Contradiction Resolver + Decision Journal
Action Selection / Expected Utility ranks candidate actions
Context Orchestrator rebuilds final prompt according to Logic Mode budget
Learned strategy hints for current mode
Any real action remains separate behind Tool Registry + Permission Gate

metacognition.meaning: Техническая оценка опоры ответа на доступные данные, не эмоция и не измерение сознания.

checks: explicit safe project text file read when filename/path appears in request
Cloud.ru consistency analysis constrained to collected evidence
verification_engine.critical_rule: Cloud.ru consistency pass не является независимым источником истины; он только проверяет согласованность уже собранных свидетельств.
verification_engine.re_assessment: После проверки Metacognition запускается повторно; именно final assessment ограничивает финальный ответ.

principles: tool status=success required before claiming completion

integrity_notes: Этот файл не содержит API-ключей, паролей или иных секретов.
Recent commits взяты непосредственно из GitHub API на момент handoff.
Repository tree взят непосредственно из main на момент handoff.

modes.PLAN: цель, зависимости, следующий шаг, критерий завершения

logic_engine.safety_rule: Decision Journal хранит только техническую трассу решения и evidence; скрытые внутренние chain-of-thought не сохраняются и не экспонируются.
logic_engine.verification_rule: Modes VERIFY and DIAGNOSE force Verification Engine before final response.

context_orchestrator.rule: Context budget controls only the current prompt; it never deletes long-term memory.

causal_reasoning.rule: Temporal order or correlation alone must not be reported as proven causality. Evidence must support both cause and effect; contradictions lower confidence.

hypothesis_manager.safety_rule: Highest-confidence hypothesis is still a hypothesis until evidence resolves it.

logic_learning.safety_rule: Assistant-generated answers never self-confirm strategy success.

counterfactual_reasoning.safety_rule: Counterfactual scenarios are conditional models, not guaranteed predictions. Unsupported effects remain explicitly uncertain.

decision_quality.safety_rule: Overall score measures decision-basis quality, not truth, correctness or certainty of outcome.

formula_components: benefit = counterfactual scenario confidence × decision quality
action_selection.safety_rule: Selection never executes a tool. Tool Registry and Permission Gate remain authoritative; ask requires explicit approval and deny blocks execution.
